component.name: DeathPush
component.summary: A standalone desktop Git client with the VS Code Source Control UX

description.p: DeathPush is a standalone desktop Git client that replicates the VS Code Source Control UX. Native diffs, clean staging, branch management, file history, and zero bloat. Built with GPUI and Rust.

ul.li: VS Code Source Control UX: familiar staging workflow with inline diff toggles and file-level staging
Native diffs: syntax highlighting, side-by-side or unified views, and per-hunk stage, unstage, and discard
Branch management: create, switch, merge, rebase, rename, and delete branches with full remote tracking
Image diffs: side-by-side image diffs for PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, and more
Git blame and file history: current-line blame in the status bar, plus file history and commit diffs
Stash, tags, and cherry-pick: stash management, tag creation, and cherry-pick support
Multi-window: open repositories in separate windows, each with its own branches and state
Theme support: built-in themes including dark, light, and high-contrast variants
Built with Rust: GPUI desktop app for fast startup and low memory usage
